records.issue_text: [High/bug] `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:75` — Salesforce refreshes directly against Salesforce instead of through `refreshOAuthTokens()`, so credential sync has no effect for Salesforce credentials.
records.rationale: Verifiable from the diff: the newly added Salesforce refresh code in CalendarService.ts calls `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` directly, whereas every other app modified in this PR (google-calendar, hubspot, lark, office365, webex, zoho, zoom) routes its token refresh through the new `refreshOAuthTokens()` so the credential-sync endpoint is honored. The finding's mechanism — Salesforce credentials bypass `refreshOAuthTokens()`, so `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` sync has no effect for Salesforce — is accurate to the diff. Whether this omission is intentional

records.issue_text: [High/bug] `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts:91` — when sync is enabled, the helper returns a Fetch `Response`, but the Axios flow reads `tokenInfo.data`, which is undefined for Fetch responses, so refreshed credentials are not processed.
records.rationale: In zoho-bigin CalendarService, the axios call is replaced by refreshOAuthTokens wrapper; the new refreshOAuthTokens returns fetch's Response when sync is enabled (returns `response` from fetch), while the caller reads `tokenInfo.data`, which only exists on an Axios response. When sync is disabled, the wrapper returns the axios response so `.data` works; when enabled, `.data` is undefined, so refreshed credential processing breaks. Same mismatch pattern applies to other axios callers too.

records.issue_text: [High/bug] `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts:204` — when sync is enabled, the helper returns a Fetch `Response`, while the Axios-based code accesses `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data`, so the refresh path fails to consume the synced token response.
records.rationale: refreshOAuthTokens returns either the callback's return value (Axios response, with .data) or a fetch Response (with no .data). In zohocrm CalendarService, when credential sync is enabled and userId is set, `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data` would be undefined, breaking the refresh path. The diff confirms the helper uses fetch and the caller accesses .data.
